title: Press Release Sixfold Bioscience to Present Two Talks at NextGen Biomed 2025 Feb 27, 2025 Read more
body_markdown:
The three day conference held in London on the 12-14th of march 2025 will cover a range of topics on sequence driven therapeutics, and will feature leading industry experts from the fields of RNA, Peptides and Antibodies, including: Roche, AstraZeneca, GSK, Genentech, Moderna and Sanofi.


‍


Dr Anna Perdrix Rosell


Track Keynote: March 14th, 09:00am (GMT)


- “Beyond The Liver: Advancing Computational & Chemical Strategies For Oligo Delivery”


‍


Dr Reeta Daswani


Presentation: March 12th, 12:05pm (GMT)


- ‘Beyond N=1: Multiplexing As A HT Tool For Screening Delivery Conjugates In Vivo’
